results.title: Father’s Day
excerpts:
Father’s Day is a special day to honor and appreciate fathers and father figures . It is a time to express gratitude for the men who offer love, guidance, and care for children. Father figures can include biological fathers, stepfathers, grandfathers, fathers-in-law, guardians (such as foster parents), male relatives, and family friends who play an important role in a child’s life. Around the world, people celebrate this day to thank their dads and acknowledge the lasting impact fathers and father figures have on families and communities.
